2026-01 Notice of Intent - Canoe Procurement Group

- Dec 30, 2025
  • Tenders

 

As required by Chapter Five, Article 504.7 of the Canadian Free Trade Agreement, the City of Dawson Creek (“the City”) hereby provides notice that it is a member of Canoe Procurement Group of Canada (“Canoe”) and is eligible to procure through the cooperative contracts that are administered by Canoe.  The City intends to participate in one or more Canoe led procurements over the period of  January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026.

Canoe is a not-for-profit group purchasing organization that leverages the collective buying power of more than 6,000 member organizations.  Through its trade-compliant procurement processes, Canoe provides access to a wide range of competitively priced goods and services. For further information about Canoe, please visit the website at www.canoeprocurement.ca.

For further information and access to the Canoe Request for Proposal (RFP) notices, please visit the Canoe Procurement portal at  www.canoe.bidsandtenders.ca or the BC Bid website at www.bcbid.gov.bc.ca.

Vendors interested in becoming a Canoe approved supplier must follow the Canoe registration and competitive RFP process. More information is available at https://canoeprocurement.ca/suppliers/get-approved/.

All enquiries specific to this Notice of Intent, may be made in writing to Jill Rickert, Procurement Officer at jrickert@dawsoncreek.ca.
